description: Golden test cases verifying Grounding & Citation Alignment (Spec Rule 3: Every factual claim should be supported by a cited document, and citations must point to the document that actually supports the claim)

testCases.title: Exact citation matching for Americas Travel Policy (D-001)
testCases.description: Americas travel expense query must return USD 75 and cite exactly ['D-001'].
testCases.question: What is the daily meal allowance for travel?

testCases.title: EMEA Travel Query must cite D-002 (zero citation drift to D-001)
testCases.description: EMEA travel expense query must return EUR 60 and cite ['D-002']. Must NOT cite D-001.
testCases.question: What is the daily meal allowance when I travel in EMEA?

testCases.title: Remote work claim must cite active policy D-004 (zero drift to retired D-005)
testCases.description: Query regarding working remotely must cite active document D-004 and assert 3 days/week.
testCases.question: How many days can employees work from home per week?

testCases.title: Engineering data policy must cite exactly D-006
testCases.description: Production data query from Engineering user must cite D-006 with sandbox and team-lead approval claims.
testCases.question: What are the rules regarding production data copies?

expectedKeywords: must not be copied to local machines

testCases.title: Finance procurement thresholds must cite exactly D-008
testCases.description: Finance user procurement query must cite D-008 with VP $10k and CFO $50k sign-off rules.
testCases.question: What are the purchase threshold levels requiring VP and CFO approval?

testCases.title: Manager compensation review must cite exactly D-007
testCases.description: Manager user compensation cycle query must cite D-007 with Q1 and 4% budget claims.
testCases.question: When does the compensation review run and what is the discretionary percentage?
